description: This file defines the pass management system for Torch JIT, including registration, clearing, and handling of compiler passes that modify the IR graph, with support for custom pre- and post-differentiation passes.

classes.name: RegisterPostPass
classes.description: Legacy registration struct for post passes.

classes.name: PassManager
classes.description: Template class managing registration and deregistration of graph passes, designed for static storage and derived classes.

methods.name: isRegistered
methods.description: Checks or sets registration status of a pass.

methods.name: passID
methods.description: Gets or sets the ID of the registered pass.

methods.name: registerPass
methods.description: Registers a new pass if not already registered.
